source_checks.note: The final technical publication was re-read. It confirms the essay's COLLAPSE/SURVIVE task partition, the top-ten J-space ablation, the L38-L54 band, the detached/mechanical experiential-register result, and the stated limitations. This discharges the article's final paper re-verification request but does not cure the independent R_V implementation obligation.
Belrose et al. supports the tuned-lens description and historical contrast. The article does not make the tuned lens carry its novel R_V claims.
The first-party research publication supports the sparse-autoencoder/feature-dictionary background and the limits the essay attributes to feature-level interpretation.
The circuit-tracing publication supports the essay's description of attribution graphs as a causal-mechanistic advance over static activation inspection. It is background rather than proof of R_V.

Sarkar and Deka support the reported causal-dimensionality measure kappa and the 15.6x versus 4.35x contrast. The essay keeps this adjacent result distinct from R_V and does not claim metric equivalence.

The manuscript supports the article's canonical Mistral V-projection figures and model-family caveats, including Hedges' g -1.864, the confidence interval and range, stripped-versus-canonical prompt contrast, and divergent control-model results. It does not supply the missing canonical Gemma hook_v run.
The internal audit supports the article's caution that R_V/J-space proximity remains untested and confirms that measurements from different R_V backends must not be pooled.
The implementation defines the canonical probe on value-projection hook_v activations, establishing one of the mutually non-equivalent R_V backends that the article says must be reconciled.

The Gemma probe uses hidden-state activations rather than the canonical hook_v value projections, confirming the backend mismatch. The inspected artifacts contain no completed canonical Gemma hook_v result.

The production helper's documentation refers to value representations while its operative extraction uses full-sequence hidden states, confirming a third implementation that cannot be silently treated as the canonical paper measure.

The article itself makes the unresolved obligation binding: reconcile the three in-code R_V definitions and complete the canonical Gemma hook_v run before any external R_V claim. The current body still makes external R_V claims while acknowledging that the canonical Gemma run is incomplete.

hold_reasons: The article's explicit 'fix before any external R_V claim' condition is not discharged: three non-equivalent implementations remain and the canonical Gemma hook_v run is still incomplete.
Because the article publishes R_V results and cross-model interpretation, backend identity is load-bearing provenance, not a merely editorial cleanup.
unresolved_obligations: Reconcile p0_canonical_pipeline.py, gemma_recursive_awareness_probe.py, and dharma_swarm/rv.py into a typed measurement definition or explicitly segregate every result by backend.
Complete and receipt-bind the canonical Gemma value-projection hook_v run before external R_V claims are eligible for PASS.
